title: The functions the roll log names (Server/RollOrigins.json in the bridge mod)
description: Who asks the roll manager for a roll (askers) and which system decided a roll was needed (causes), by registry id, with the places the registry's build tables give each id. `places` is written by `gatekit registry places` and never by hand. GK.RollLog: docs/contracts/lua-api.md#gkrolls-rolls-decided-in-advance-serverrollslua

id.description: The registry id of the function.

what.description: The roll it asks for, in a few words.

entry.description: One of the roll manager's own entry functions: the asker is the frame above it.

cause.description: The word the roll log's row carries as its cause.

statusApplied.description: The function above a status's condition when the status is being applied; without it the condition was asked on a later event of the status.

places.description: By build, then by executable, then by id: [rva, size in bytes].
